description: This script automates the creation of leave policy assignments based on employee current leave policies and employee grades within an ERP system, updating leave allocations accordingly.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the creation and updating of leave policy assignments based on employee data.

methods.name: create_assignment
methods.description: Creates a leave policy assignment for an employee, optionally based on leave period, and updates related leave allocations.

methods.name: get_employee_with_grade
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees filtered by their grade.
